evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative directive performing a settled instruction the speaker expects carried out — decision-grade by its performed act, not merely an argued position.
Operational imperative with 'all' scoping expects compliance and acts on the settlement — decision, not a claim still being argued.
Flat unhedged assertive stated as fact but without ratification or performed-settling language — claim, not decision.
